name: Lord Hanuman
shortDescription: The embodiment of devotion, courage and selfless service.
description: Hanuman, devoted servant of Sri Rama, is remembered for boundless courage held in perfect humility. His gada stands for strength placed in service, and the name of Rama is ever on his lips. Sit with him and draw on steadiness, courage and devotion.

art.imageAlt: Gada with a saffron banner bearing the name of Rama, before the rising sun
